Item Submitter: sjw46
SF URL:
https://sourceforge.net/support/tracker.php?aid=1658394
Consider including this as part of
(Allow DC, RELS-EXT etc to be managed content) - and also consider including in migration tool as part of

Added some statistics for managed audit datastreams. As can be seen the outliers are gone and the performance degradation is mitigated a bit. A second graph with a managed audit trail serialization format using attributes and therefore being less verbose has been added
Frank, can you confirm the following:
i) versionable.gif: stock Fedora 3.6.1 with Managed datastreams, versionable=true
ii) managed_audit_xstream_attributes.gif: modified Fedora 3.6.1 with Managed datastreams, versionable=true, Managed Audit datastream using alternate audit xml serialization format
iii) managed_audit_xstream_plain.gif: modified Fedora 3.6.1 with Managed datastreams, versionable=true, Managed Audit datastream using original audit xml serialization format
In particular, I wasn't sure if ii) and iii) had versioned datastreams or not
@Eddie:
I) Confirmed. versionable.gif was created with a default fedora install
II) Confirmed: managed_audit_xstream_attributes.gif was created using a versionable managed datastream with an XML format that relies on attributes to decrease verbosity.
III) Confirmed:managed_audit_xstream_attributes.gif was created using a versionable managed datastream with Fedora's default Audit-XML format.
Yes..Both II and III used versioned managed datastreams.
This seems like a trivial change so long as it is just adding AUDIT to the list of DS's that are affected by the server configuration for default internal DS types.  Am I misreading it?
No further releases planned for 3.x

The Audit trail datastream is currently inline XML. When an object has lots of changes a large audit trail will be inlined within the object, bloating the XML file for the object. We want to be able to store the audit trail as managed content or simply in a repository log file. We should consider whether we should allow the choice to be a repository-wide configuration option, and/or an object-specific option.  Also, consider what the default choice should be.
